messages.body_plain:
Dear Basta Users!
I would like to calculate life expectancy of both sexes in capture
recapture right censored data sets of tigers. I am using Basta. Can you
please help me by providing R codes with explanation?
Regards,
Mriganka
PhD student
Wildlife Institute of India
INDIA

messages.subject: [Basta-users] (no subject)
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mriganka,

if you include lifeTable = TRUE in your basta-function a cohort life 
table will be calculated from the estimated ages at death for each of 
the categorical covariates (sex in your case). These life tables give 
you the average remaining life expectancy in column "ex". You call the 
life tables simply by using ModelName$lifeTable.

Best wishes,
Maren
